whatStopsIt.sourceIdentity: official-form:Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs or an Appeal Bond
whatStopsIt.measurement: Group10 is one top-level radio field with four kid widgets and export values Choice1..Choice4. Two widgets are on page 3 at item 3, "Are you represented by Legal Aid? Check only one box", and two are on page 9 at item 9, "Ability to Pay Court Costs. Check only one box". A radio group holds one selection.
whatStopsIt.whyThatMatters: this route determines both answers - a self-represented filer who cannot afford court costs - and the form can record one of them or the other, never both.
threeWaysPastItThatThisLaneDidNotTake: declaring the two as participant elections, which would launder route-determined elections to keep a counter at zero
drawing marks beside the widgets, which would put ink on a declaration sworn under penalty of perjury through a control the form does not provide
editing the binary to split the field, which would change the structure of a form the Supreme Court of Texas approved in Misc. Docket No. 22-9090
whatStopsIt.whichReadingIsTrueCannotBeSettledHere: whether the Court's own published form carries this, or whether the copy held under private/human-source-returns/TX/ was re-fielded by whoever returned it, cannot be established from what is mounted. Both readings make it a source question.

whatWouldUnblockIt: a Statement of Inability binary whose item-3 and item-9 elections are separate AcroForm fields, or
an owner determination that this packet may mark those two elections outside the form's own controls, or
an owner determination that the fee-waiver component may be dropped from this family's declared set and replaced by the $28 fee the OCA instructions name as its alternative

surveyRecordedSoTheNextLaneDoesNotRepeat.letterElectionsTheRouteWouldDetermine: the five numbered eligibility statements on pages 4 and 5 are the route's own eligibility, and the OCA instructions say in terms that a filer unable to mark each one is ineligible. Two drop-downs on the letter carry source-authored defaults that make substantive statements: Dropdown1 defaults to "nolo contendere" and Dropdown4 and Dropdown6 both default to "have not", which read as "I have not attached a copy". Any build of this component must decide each of those deliberately.
